title: Settings → Email: Send test email through verified sending domain
journey: Sign in as franchisee@gmail.com (admin of Test Fitness Franchise)
Seed an email_domains row with status='verified' (so Send test button is enabled)
Reload /dashboard/settings/email — verified row should appear in the Sending domains table
In Actions column, confirm the 'Send test' button is enabled (was disabled for pending/verifying rows)
Click 'Send test' — Send test email dialog opens
Confirm the recipient input prefills with the current session user email
Confirm the From-line preview reads 'support@<domain>' (or the row's default_local_part)
Leave alias label empty and submit
Wait for the success toast 'Test email sent to <recipient>'
Confirm the email_logs row exists with status='sent', from_address matches verified domain
Re-open Send test, type aliasLabel 'billing' (matching a curated alias row if present), submit, verify second toast + second log row
